Pawwell https://pawwell.example.test/ | Multiple Engineering + Product Roles | Remote US or Ontario, Canada | Full Time

Pawwell offers pet care plans that pay for routine veterinary visits. We are growing the team across the board.

Open roles:

Full-Stack Software Engineer: build and ship across our web apps, payments and data systems.

We look for at least three years of relevant experience. Our stack is Node.js, React, PostgreSQL and AWS. The product itself does not feature AI components.

Apply at https://jobs.gem.com/pawwell
